verdict.rationale: Wise's first-party docs describe a multi-currency account that lets users hold, convert, and fund transfers from balances in up to 56 currencies, with payments and receipts in 40+ currencies and balance statements available in many formats. This directly delivers holding and managing multi-currency balances from one account. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-currency balance management, and in-depth documentation of balance management operations such as opening or closing currency balances.

support.subject: As a founder, I can hold and manage balances in multiple currencies from one account

citations.quote: The Wise multi-currency account (MCA) enables users to hold, convert, and fund transfers (single or batches) with balances in up to 56 currencies.
Make payments and get paid in 40+ currencies.
Statements can be retrieved in multiple formats: JSON, CSV, PDF, XLSX, CAMT.053, MT940, or QIF.
